title: Upper-shadow comparisons on the slice and the Frankl--Tokushige product conjectures
summary: Let $\mathcal{F}\subseteq\binom{[n]}k$, and let $\partial_{k\to\ell}\mathcal{F}$ be the family of all $\ell$-sets containing a member of $\mathcal{F}$. Writing $μ_k(\mathcal{F})=|\mathcal{F}|/\binom nk$, $p=k/n$, and $q=\ell/n$, we prove $$ μ_\ell(\partial_{k\to\ell}\mathcal{F})\geq \begin{cases}μ_k(\mathcal{F})^{\frac{\log q}{\log p}}, &0\leq μ_k(\mathcal{F})\leq p^2,\\ q\left[1-\left(1-\frac{μ_k(\mathcal{F})}{p}\right)^{ \frac{\log(1-q)}{\log(1-p)}} \ \ \right], &p^2\leq μ_k(\mathcal{F})\leq p,\\ 1-(1-μ_k(\mathcal{F}))^{\frac{\log(1-q)}{\log(1-p)}}, &p\leq μ_k(\mathcal{F})\leq1.…
